subject: Qualifying offer (MLB)
query: what is a qualifying offer in mlb
title: What is a qualifying offer in MLB? $23.15 million, decide by Nov. 17
answer: A qualifying offer is a one-year contract that an MLB team can offer its own departing free agent. For the 2026-27 offseason it is worth $23.15 million, the average of the 125 highest salaries in baseball. Players have until 3 p.m. Central on Nov. 17 to accept; if one declines and signs elsewhere, his old team gets a draft pick.
body:
Eight players received the offer in early November 2026: Randy Arozarena (Mariners), Jake Bauers (Brewers), David Bednar (Yankees), Ryan Jeffers (Twins), Brandon Lowe (Pirates), Adrián Morejón (Padres), Trevor Rogers (Orioles) and Seiya Suzuki (Cubs). The amount is a record, up from $22.025 million a year earlier. A team can make the offer only if the player spent the whole season with it, and a player can receive one only once in his career. A player who accepts cannot be traded without his consent until June 15.

The draft pick is what makes the offer matter. The pick the old team receives depends on its finances and the size of the new contract: a revenue-sharing team losing a player who signs for $50 million or more gets a pick after the first round, while a team that paid the luxury tax gets one only after the fourth round. The team that signs him pays a price too: a club over the luxury tax forfeits its second- and fifth-highest picks plus $1 million in international bonus money.

Last offseason 13 players got the offer and 4 accepted it: Trent Grisham, Shota Imanaga, Gleyber Torres and Brandon Woodruff. This year the rule may be living its final winter: the labor contract that created it expires at 11:59 p.m. Eastern on Dec. 1, 2026, and a new deal could change or drop it.
in_the_news: MLB teams made qualifying offers to eight free agents after the 2026 World Series, and the players must decide by Nov. 17.

faq.q: How much is the MLB qualifying offer for 2026?
faq.a: $23.15 million for one year, a record and up from $22.025 million the year before.

faq.q: When is the qualifying offer deadline?
faq.a: Players must accept or reject by 3 p.m. Central (4 p.m. Eastern) on Nov. 17, 2026.

faq.q: What happens if a player rejects the qualifying offer?
faq.a: He becomes a normal free agent. If he signs with a different team, his former team receives a compensatory draft pick and the new team gives up one or more picks.

faq.q: Who received a qualifying offer in 2026?
faq.a: Randy Arozarena, Jake Bauers, David Bednar, Ryan Jeffers, Brandon Lowe, Adrián Morejón, Trevor Rogers and Seiya Suzuki.
